# FIXTURE ONLY: shaped like the PR-B hosted executor workflows (87cb65fb layout); not the frozen PR-B bytes.
name: contract-placement

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: gate
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  contract-placement:
    name: contract-placement-hosted-executor
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Enforce placement
        run: python3 -I -B scripts/ci/check_contract_placement.py --fixture
      - name: Emit relay identity
        # Hex, not the JWT text: GitHub masks JWT-shaped text in logs and annotations (Task 169fd456).
        run: |
          set -eu
          tokenhex="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=clued-hosted-relay-v1" \
            | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["value"].encode("ascii").hex())')"
          echo "::notice title=clued-hosted-relay-v1::$tokenhex"
